versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Magpies and crows who borrow gold now and pay it back later, with interest.
Payoffs grow from how much you owe in a fight, how often you repay, or how much you have repaid all game.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Repay payoffs now share one trigger word, Repaid:, so it's clear what Thought and Memory repeats and how the twice-a-round cap counts fight Skims.
Mr Magpie and Uncle Jack got clear rules for zero Debt and leftover sale value, and Penny Jackdaw borrows 3 so it buys a unit at once.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Every Debt repaid now goes into the Ledger, whether paid in gold, by a Skim or by a sale, and Arne counts Debt repaid, so Corbie, Bookkeeper and Arne read one way.
Slate-Drinker Rook now grows when repaid, so it is no longer a gold-losing trap off-build.
